scope.notTested: Subdomain Domain-suffix matching (the permitted hosts are only 127.0.0.1 and localhost), Partitioned/CHIPS cookies, third-party-cookie setting permutations, private suffix/public-suffix edge cases, cookie eviction/quota, cross-process profiles, service workers, and TLS transport. One default third-party iframe context was probed; this does not establish behavior under other profile settings.
scope.referrer: Cross-site source HTML is served with Referrer-Policy: no-referrer. Each request records actual Referer, Cookie, Origin, Authorization, method, and Sec-Fetch-Site headers observed by the loopback server.
scope.cache: All probe responses use Cache-Control: no-store. A single fresh Playwright browser context shares the cookie jar across the recorded sequence.
